label: ex-recovering-the-coordinates-of-an-ordered-pair
tail:
VERDICT: CLEAN
BOUNDARY: Checked a=b (pair becomes a singleton; all equalities hold and the difference is correctly empty), a=∅, b=∅, both ∅, and arbitrary a,b with a∈b, b∈a, etc. The reasoning is uniform and nowhere assumes a≠b or any special property of a,b. The nonemptiness condition for ⋂(a,b) is satisfied because {a}∈(a,b). The difference is ∅ exactly when a=b, and {b} otherwise, so the second coordinate is always recovered.
CHECKED: Read every numbered verification step (1.1, 1.2, 2.1, 2.2, 3.1) and every cited fact (L1–L11) against the full text of each dependency. Every fact is faithfully rendered, and every step is mathematically licensed by the cited material.
